bestBets.overview: SECRET SUSPICION was beaten just on a length after leading at Eagle Farm two starts back before disappointing at same venue last start. Lightly raced and she gets chance to get maiden out of the way. CRUDO joins new stable for Birdsville debut. Poor last start but he has plenty of early speed and expect he will go forward and take some catching. Les Tilley jumps on BARRYTHEBARBARIC and he is coming off a last start Roma placing so cannot leave out while OUTAGES was placed at Toowoomba two starts back an that would be competitive.

raceTips.comment: SECRET SUSPICION is a recent addition to the Manzelmann yard. She was just collared late at Eagle Farm two runs back but failed to figure last time off a wide draw. She’s fit and will find this easier. CRUDO has also found his way to a new home and should find this easier than what he’s previously contested. He’s first up so fitness is the main query but the 1200m will suit. FILLYDELPHIA MISS has been freshened as she drops back from 1560m. Back to maiden grade after tackling a BM70 last start, she looks well placed and gets in nicely with the claim. BARRYTHEBARBARIC is hard fit and can figure.

bestBets.overview: MAYOR OF KINGSTON gets his chance to return to winners stall. He comes to Birdsville off a last start Cairns placing and with advantage of apprentice claim he looks well placed. SMASHING ROSIE gave a Longreach field a galloping lesson last start. Drawn ideally and if she produces similatr she can get away with this. HI FRANK was little one paced but battled on well and held placing at Roma last start. He is a must for exotics while STARLITE REBEL has been battling of late but if she can somehow find best would make presence felt.

raceTips.comment: SMASHING ROSIE comes off a dominant five length win at Longreach. She steps out to the mile for the first time but the way she finds the line suggests it will suit. MAYOR OF KINGSTON has been placed at his past two starts and looks nearing another win. Down in class and back out to the mile, he’ll be strong late. STARLITE REBEL strips fitter second up and will appreciate the rise in journey. She has won over this track and trip previously and must be included. HI FRANK comes off a third placing at Roma. He’s fit and the mile suits.

bestBets.overview: MISS MONEYPENNY made it two in a row winning at Cairns last st art. If she can hold her form she can keep on her winning ways. QUELLO DORATO joins new stable. He came from a long way back to win on the synthetic two starts back before making late ground last start. He is up to this. FOREVER A DIAMOND won at Pioneer Park two starts back before being beaten less than a length last outing. Drawn perfectly and looks a chance while ENGELINE was beaten less than a length at Cairns last outing and that good form for this.

raceTips.comment: MISS MONEYPENNY has done plenty of travelling but she continues to race well. She made it back to back wins when saluting at Cairns on Saturday and she looks well placed dropping back in grade. QUELLO DORATO will make his first appearance for the Clint Austin yard. He’s untried on the dirt has performed well on the synthetic and if he produces his best, he’ll take beating. HERE I COME put together successive wins on the dirt but failed to fire last start at Charleville. He’s hard fit and can bounce back. ENGELINE was beaten less than a length last start behind Miss Moneypenny and she gets in well with the claim.

bestBets.overview: PRIVATE SHOWTIME battled on well enough when placed at Beaudesert last start. She has been placed in two of last three starts and that form good enough to figure in this. ANDERS KISS won maiden at Rockhampton two starts back then went to Cairns and was not disgraced. Drawn perfectly and she will be in finish. BOULEVARD BOY comes into this off a last start placing. No harder and must consider while FARNESINA did enough when placed fresh to suggest she may fill a first four spot.

raceTips.comment: FARNESINA just found one better on the day when resuming at Muttaburra. She strips fitter and the 2kg claim sees her in nicely. ANDERS KISS let down strongly to score over 1050m at Rockhampton two runs back and wasn’t far away last time in stronger company. Back in grade, she looks a top chance. PRIVATE SHOWTIME steps out for the new stable. Placed in two of her past three runs, she’s since been freshened and will find this easier. KINDLY resumes. She races well fresh and the 1200m kick off will suit.

bestBets.overview: Hard to knock the winning form of GREAT COSMIC. Made it three in a row with a soft win at Mount Isa last start. He goes on top again and can continue his winning run. IOANE took on a much better race in Adelaide first-up and looked in need of the run. He may find the front and prove hard to run down from the corner. STECARA finished too well winning at Emerald two starts back before poor effort last start. She can bounce back while FRAWLEY chased home well enough when placed at Mount Isa last start. Would include him in first four wagers.

raceTips.comment: GREAT COSMIC is unbeaten in four runs for the Jay Morris yard and will look to make it five straight. Given a seven-week let up after his latest triumph at Julia Creek, he proved too good at Mt Isa. Fitter for that run, the rise to 1200m will suit. DEFERENTIAL has been freshened since his first up win at Corfield. He too strips fitter and will appreciate the extra furlong. STERCARA just looked in need of the run last start. She will have taken plenty of improvement from it and Paul Hamblin sticks with her. FRAWLEY comes off a solid effort to finish second despite a wide run. He gets the inside draw this time and a senior rider to steer.

bestBets.overview: HELLO WORLD was placed in Adelaide two starts back then dominant winning last start. This looks a nice race for him to go on and win again. LUCKY FORTUNA started favourite in the race won by Hello World last start but missed a placing. She had win prior and can bounce back. REVOLT won three in a row before fading late at Eagle Farm last start. Won only try this track/distance and must respect. PESHWA made it two in a row leading all the way at Roma last start. If he can find the front he will take catching.

raceTips.comment: REVOLT resumes. He’s proven first up and is unbeaten in four starts over 1000m. Having won this race last year, it’s safe to say, he’s ideally placed. HELLO WORLD kicked off for the new yard with a win over 1000m at Betoota. He does step out to open company but drops sharply in the weights. PESHWA is hard fit and looking to make it three straight wins. There was plenty for merit in his latest performance as he carried the full 71.5kgs at Roma. The drop back to 1000m is a query but he’ll be strong late. COCHRANE comes off a dominant win in the Cairns Lightning. He gets the inside draw and will be in it for a long way.
